narrative.overview: A restrained native desktop workspace keeps project navigation available while the conversation remains the main working area. The interface uses gpui-kit components, compact controls and a user-selected verdant theme rather than a fixed brand palette.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent project and session navigation with an active session title in the inset work area.
A centred conversation and composer lane with auxiliary history and terminal regions on demand.
Semantic theme colours and native control states, including keyboard focus.
dos: Do use semantic theme roles and preserve user-selected light and dark themes.
Do keep session context statistics labelled according to what the gateway reported.
Do use native components, accessible control names and visible interaction states.
donts: Don't replace dynamic colours with a fixed palette.
Don't present context-window capacity as current usage.
Don't treat the deferred editor or generative UI as implemented.
